moisture_pct.quote: * Sample description: “My proposal: Sage-Derby; the middle layer of the cheese is made with extract from fresh sage leaves.” Analysis: Composition: % Moisture 36-39

salt_pct.quote: * Sample description: same Sage-Derby proposal as 1a. Salt 2

ammonia.reason: Low deamination in young rindless block with little free NH3 accumulation.

animal_barnyard.reason: Pasteurized milk and clean Lactococcus culture give very low p-cresol and indole.

bitter.reason: Limited hydrophobic peptides from chymosin and starter peptidases in short age.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti, so no 2-heptanone and 2-nonanone methyl ketones.

browning.reason: Moderate Maillard of residual galactose and amino acids when heated.

buttery.reason: Diacetyl and acetoin from Lactococcus lactis citrate metabolism in young curd.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Low butanoic and hexanoic acids from limited lipolysis during 1-3 mo aging.

creaminess.reason: 28-30% fat in 36-39% moisture pressed matrix gives moderate palate coating.

crumbliness.reason: Cheddared-type acidified pressed curd fractures readily at 1-3 mo.

firmness.reason: Moisture ~36% pressed semi-hard matrix gives firm-sliceable body.

floral_honey.reason: Sage leaf 1,8-cineole, camphor and thujone plus low phenylacetaldehyde add herbal-floral.

fruity.reason: Few ethyl butanoate and ethyl hexanoate esters due to short aging and low lipolysis.

goaty.reason: Cow milk lacks caprine 4-methyloctanoic and 4-ethyloctanoic acids.

malty_nutty.reason: Low Strecker 3-methylbutanal and 2-methylbutanal from limited proteolysis.

melt.reason: pH ~5.3 calcium-solubilized para-casein network flows readily when heated.

mushroom_earthy.reason: No mold-derived 1-octen-3-ol; only faint sage-derived green notes.

oil_off.reason: Moderate free-fat coalescence on heating, limited by young intact protein network.

smoky.reason: Unsmoked curd with no wood-smoke guaiacol or syringol.

sour_vinegar.reason: Lactic acid from starter fermentation plus trace acetic acid at pH ~5.3.

stretch.reason: Non-pasta-filata, proteolyzed network lacks aligned demineralized fibers.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Minimal methionine-derived methanethiol and dimethyl sulfide without high cook.

sweet.reason: Lactose largely fermented; faint sweet from milkfat and low-acid balance.

umami.reason: Short proteolysis yields modest glutamate with no long-aged peptide boost.
